measures.label: average temperature over the year
measures.how: mean of the 12 monthly mean temperatures (day and night)

measures.label: average temperature of the warmest month
measures.how: highest of the 12 monthly means

measures.label: average temperature of the coldest month
measures.how: lowest of the 12 monthly means

measures.label: gap between the warmest and coldest month
measures.how: warmest monthly mean minus coldest monthly mean

measures.label: average day high over the year
measures.how: mean of the 12 monthly average daily maximums

measures.label: average night low over the year
measures.how: mean of the 12 monthly average daily minimums

measures.label: average gap between day high and night low
measures.how: mean over the year of day high minus night low

measures.label: average day high of the hottest month
measures.how: highest monthly average daily maximum

measures.label: average night low of the coldest month
measures.how: lowest monthly average daily minimum

measures.label: yearly precipitation (rain and snow as water)
measures.how: sum of the 12 monthly totals

measures.label: precipitation of the wettest month
measures.how: highest monthly total

measures.label: months with under 30 mm of precipitation
measures.how: count of months below 30 mm

measures.label: yearly sunshine
measures.how: sum of the 12 monthly hours of bright sunshine

measures.label: average wind speed
measures.how: mean of the 12 monthly mean speeds about 10 m above the ground

measures.label: average relative humidity
measures.how: mean over the year of the humidity calculated from dew point, night low and day high

measures.label: average dew point
measures.how: mean of the 12 monthly mean dew points

measures.label: months with an average dew point of 18 °C or more
measures.how: count of months with mean dew point >= 18 °C

measures.label: yearly fresh snow
measures.how: sum of the 12 monthly snowfalls (1 mm of water ≈ 1 cm of snow)

measures.label: months with snow on the ground (average depth 1 cm or more)
measures.how: count of months with mean snow depth >= 1 cm

measures.label: average sea surface temperature nearby (coastal areas only)
measures.how: mean of the 12 monthly sea temperatures of the nearest sea within 60 km

measures.label: sea surface temperature in the warmest month (coastal areas only)
measures.how: highest monthly sea temperature

measures.label: day-to-day temperature spread (standard deviation of daily temperatures within a month)
measures.how: mean over the 12 months of the standard deviation of daily mean temperature around the month’s average

measures.label: day-to-day spread of day highs (standard deviation)
measures.how: mean over the 12 months of the standard deviation of daily highs

measures.label: day-to-day spread of night lows (standard deviation)
measures.how: mean over the 12 months of the standard deviation of daily lows

measures.label: year-to-year temperature spread (standard deviation of a month’s average from one year to the next)
measures.how: mean over the 12 months of the standard deviation of the monthly mean temperature across 1981–2010

measures.label: how much a month’s precipitation varies from year to year (standard deviation as % of its average)
measures.how: mean over the 12 months of the coefficient of variation of the monthly total across 1981–2010

sources: the same values as the globe: CHELSA V2.1 + station adjustment (temperature, rain, wind), CRU CL 2.0 (sunshine, day-night range), ERA5-Land (dew point, snow), ERA5 (sea temperature, day-to-day spread), ERA5-Land monthly (year-to-year spread); 1981-2010
